dedupe_keys.name: usda forest service tree canopy cover science tcc and nlcd tcc

description: The Tree Canopy Cover product suite gives the percentage of each 30 m pixel covered by tree canopy for every year from 1985 to 2025 across the conterminous United States, coastal Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands. It is developed by the USDA Forest Service, with the Geospatial Office and Forest Inventory and Analysis, and the NLCD version is released as a partner of the Multi-Resolution Land Characteristics Consortium. Version 2025.6, released in 2026, has two products: the Science TCC, with raw model outputs and a standard error layer, and the NLCD TCC, masked for water and non-tree agriculture and filtered to reduce year-to-year noise. Format and access: yearly raster files downloaded from the Forest Service page and the MRLC site. Licence: U.S. federal data with no use restriction stated, under a Forest Service disclaimer; free. Caveats: the Science version can show canopy over water or irrigated fields, and 30 m pixels blur street trees. It serves urban heat, stormwater and vegetation-to-power-line exposure analysis and green infrastructure planning. A related catalogue record is the Meta and WRI 1 m global canopy height map, a finer but single-date alternative.
